officialTitle: Lung adjuvant cisplatin evaluation: a pooled analysis by the LACE Collaborative Group

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Individual patient data were collected and pooled from the five largest trials (4,584 patients) of cisplatin-based chemotherapy in completely resected patients
design.notes: Individual-patient-data pooled analysis of five randomised trials of cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy; analyses stratified by trial.

clinicalQuestion: Which patients and which cisplatin-based regimens derive the greatest survival benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy after complete resection of NSCLC?

pico.population: Completely resected NSCLC enrolled in the five largest cisplatin-based adjuvant trials
pico.outcomes: OS overall and by stage, partner drug and patient characteristics

publications.title: Lung adjuvant cisplatin evaluation: a pooled analysis by the LACE Collaborative Group.
publications.label: Individual-patient-data pooled analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: With a median follow-up time of 5.2 years, the overall HR of death was 0.89 (95% CI, 0.82 to 0.96; P = .005), corresponding to a 5-year absolute benefit of 5.4% from chemotherapy.
HR for stage IA = 1.40; 95% CI, 0.95 to 2.06
HR for stage IB = 0.93; 95% CI, 0.78 to 1.10
HR for stage II = 0.83; 95% CI, 0.73 to 0.95
HR for stage III = 0.83; 95% CI, 0.72 to 0.94

strengths: Individual patient data from the five largest modern trials
No heterogeneity of chemotherapy effect between trials
limitations: Subgroup analyses (stage, partner drug) are exploratory
Trials used different regimens and radiotherapy policies

clinicalImplications.text: Confirmed a modest OS benefit for adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy after complete resection, with benefit evident in stage II and III disease, uncertain in stage IB and potentially detrimental in stage IA.

tumourBoardPearl.text: LACE is why adjuvant cisplatin doublets are offered for resected stage II–III disease and not for stage IA.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 18506026. Pooled IPD analysis of randomised trials; phase recorded as META.
